d:
As Bihar heads into the 2025 elections, The Lallantop brings you another episode of 'Hum Bihar Ke Log' — this time, we meet the “first doctor” of rural Bihar: an ANM worker.
She’s the face of the village healthcare system, the first to respond when help is needed most. Her story is one of grit, service, and survival. Watch this powerful report by Shivani Dalakoti, Vikas Verma, and Amitesh.
Production: Vikas Verma, Amitesh Kumar, Shivani Dalakoti
Camera & Edit: Amitesh Kumar
